replacements.>El modelo es un servicio externo. Gesti: >The model is an external service. You manage the prompt, context, and evaluation.
replacements.desc:\"Seleccionas el modelo base y el p: desc:"You select the base model and provider. It is the only decision you do not continuously iterate on: the rest of the lifecycle operates on top of it."
replacements.clave:\"La elección no es técnica sino o: clave:"The choice is operational, not just technical: privacy, cost per token, and latency matter as much as model capability."
replacements.controlas:\"Proveedor, modelo base, temp: controlas:"Provider, base model, temperature, context window."
replacements.falla:\"Un modelo con política de privac: falla:"A model with an unsuitable privacy policy or unsustainable cost invalidates the project before it starts."
replacements.desc:\"Diseñas las instrucciones que def: desc:"You design the instructions that define system behavior. This is the central artifact: it defines tone, boundaries, and output format."
replacements.clave:\"El prompt es el código de tu sis: clave:"The prompt is your system's code. What used to be “retraining” here becomes “rewriting the instructions.”"
replacements.controlas:\"System prompt, instrucciones: controlas:"System prompt, task instructions, output format, guardrails."
replacements.falla:\"Una instrucción mal formulada de: falla:"A poorly worded instruction degrades performance like a bug. Without versioning it, you cannot roll back."
replacements.desc:\"Si el modelo necesita información: desc:"If the model needs internal or up-to-date information, you add a retrieval layer. How content is chunked and selected determines answer quality."
replacements.clave:\"La calidad del retrieval importa: clave:"Retrieval quality matters more than model capability in most RAG applications."
replacements.controlas:\"Chunking, embeddings, vector: controlas:"Chunking, embeddings, vector store, retrieval strategy."
replacements.falla:\"Un retrieval pobre devuelve cont: falla:"Poor retrieval returns irrelevant context and the model hallucinates even when the prompt is perfect."
replacements.desc:\"Mides si el sistema funciona segú: desc:"You measure whether the system works according to defined criteria. Without evaluation you cannot iterate with judgment: you do not know whether a prompt change improved or worsened it."
replacements.clave:\"Construir el sistema de evaluaci: clave:"Building the evaluation system before the system itself is one of the field's most underestimated practices."
replacements.controlas:\"Dataset de evaluación, crite: controlas:"Evaluation dataset, quality criteria, LLM-as-judge, human review."
replacements.falla:\"Sin evaluación iteras a ciegas:: falla:"Without evaluation you iterate blindly: prompt changes can improve one case and break five without you noticing."
replacements.desc:\"Expones el sistema vía API con co: desc:"You expose the system through an API with prompt version control. Changes are deployed like code changes: review, testing, and rollback."
replacements.clave:\"Los prompts son artefactos de so: clave:"Prompts are software artifacts. Versioning them from day one prevents silent regressions."
replacements.controlas:\"Versión del prompt, rate lim: controlas:"Prompt version, rate limiting, cost control, rollback."
replacements.falla:\"Un cambio de prompt sin control: falla:"A prompt change without version control can break the system with no way to roll back."
replacements.desc:\"En producción el mundo cambia: lo: desc:"In production the world changes: topics drift, new cases emerge, and the provider's model is updated. You iterate on the prompt and context."
replacements.clave:\"El ciclo vuelve al prompt. La me: clave:"The lifecycle returns to the prompt. Improvement in LLMOps means rewriting instructions using production evidence."
replacements.controlas:\"Deriva semántica, feedback d: controlas:"Semantic drift, user feedback, prompt A/B tests, continuous evaluation."
replacements.falla:\"Sin monitorización la degradació: falla:"Without monitoring, degradation is silent: the system still works but makes worse decisions over time."
